name: Opportunity mix by recommended action
description: What the engine is actually proposing — write something new, improve a page, refresh a page, fix something technical, or hold. A mix that swings hard towards one action is usually a detection change, not a change in stores.

name: Opportunity mix by signal
description: Which detections are firing. Signal and action are never mapped one to one, so this and the chart above are different questions and both are worth asking.

name: Share detected without Search Console
description: How much of what we propose is being decided without a store's own search data. High is not a fault, but it changes what the confidence on a card means.

name: Measured outcomes by action type
description: What actually happened 28 days after we acted, by action type. Labels are relative to each store's own median, so this is a distribution rather than a pass mark.

name: Opportunity mix
description: What the engine proposes, why, how much of it is decided without Search Console, and what came of it four weeks later.
